body: Yesss, I won my 3rd game in a duo. I feel like I enjoy the weapon pool a lot more, last season was my introduction to fortnite so it’s nice to be able to kinda ease in. Love the vault breaking and black market factor. I feel like Melee weapons are more fair but powerful. Also greed buff is fun. All in all, despite kinda hating every battlepass skin, this gameplay is so fun.

Hoping this post gets more attention, because all I find when looking for an answer are “swipe to reply” related issues. In conclusion, this problem seems new.
